critical_landmarks.name: Sarampally
critical_landmarks.protocol: Lowest municipal basin. Deep entrapment risk. Inflatable motorized boats mandatory.

critical_landmarks.name: Adloor
critical_landmarks.protocol: Low basin depression. Culvert suction trap. Reroute eastward via Lingapur Ridge.

critical_landmarks.name: Devanpally
critical_landmarks.protocol: Stormwater runoff basin. High bridge scour risk.

critical_landmarks.name: Tekriyal
critical_landmarks.protocol: River confluence. High flow velocity exceeding 1.5 m/s.

critical_landmarks.name: Lingapur
critical_landmarks.protocol: Primary high-ground evacuation corridor and convoy bypass route.
